lead.description: the replacement of a calculated value by a nearby multiple of a reporting unit, such as the nearest integer

self_checks.title: Proportional shares
self_checks.prompt: The exact shares 14.25, 7.5, 4.5 and 3.75 are each rounded half-up to an integer. What is the sum of the rounded shares?
self_checks.answer: The rounded shares are 14, 8, 5 and 4, and they sum to 31.

self_checks.title: A printed margin
self_checks.prompt: Two printed proportions are 0.851 and 0.150. By how much does their sum exceed 1?
self_checks.answer: Their sum is 1.001, which exceeds 1 by 0.001.

self_checks.title: Three numbers
self_checks.prompt: Round 2.5, 2.5 and 3.2 half-up. What is the sum of the rounded values?
self_checks.answer: The rounded values are 3, 3 and 3, and they sum to 9.
